chunks: Safwan narrated from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Mu'tamir (pilgrim performing Umrah) does not perform Tawaf with the House after the obligatory Tawaf until he shortens his hair.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on when a pilgrim should shorten their hair during Umrah relative to Tawaf?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Safwan ibn Yahya, highlighting the specific sequence where the Mu'tamir must perform Qasr (shortening hair) before undertaking the Tawaf al-Farid (obligatory Tawaf), distinguishing it from the later Tawaf al-Ifadah. This emphasizes the legal necessity of completing the primary act of exiting Ihram before engaging in subsequent circumambulations, a point of discussion among Shia jurists regarding the precise timing of ritual completion.
